notes.title: Make Your Country Dominate Again (Sequel)
notes.content:
Good news, everyone — the sequel's store page is now live!

The world isn't ready… because this time, it's a whole new kind of massive. All players are placed on one single, intense map — at the same time.

You're fighting for your country on the same map as the rest of the world. You must stand against other players, conquer the entire globe, and unite it under a single nation. Only one country will prevail.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608680/Make_Your_Country_Dominate_Again/]Wishlist the new game here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094910/03e3a1aab3ea366c056ef54c36088e6e96814daa.png[/img]

notes.title: A New Super MMO is Coming!
notes.content:
We’re incredibly grateful for the positive feedback on our first project. Thanks to your support, we stayed confident in bringing our next creation to life.

Now, countries can conquer each other. All players are still on the same global map — but this time, only one country will remain standing in the end!

The game is now even more minimalist, because you should be able to conquer the world from any of your devices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45094910/03e3a1aab3ea366c056ef54c36088e6e96814daa.png[/img]

The store page will go live very soon — as soon as Steam approves it!
